result.note: Tested the venue of the June 2026 G7 summit outreach session; the bilateral outcomes only reaffirmed existing tracks.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the outreach session of the G7 summit held at which of the following places?
questions.explain: Modi addressed the G7 outreach session in Evian, France, on rebuilding international solidarity. On the sidelines, he held bilaterals with the UAE, the United Kingdom and Canada, including a push for early entry into force of the India-UK trade deal.
questions.source: Modi addressed the G7 outreach session in Evian, France, on rebuilding international solidarity, then held bilaterals with the UAE, the United Kingdom, and Canada.
